description: Resolve a hotel to the agoda_hotel_id that track_hotel_price needs. This is a lookup step, not a hotel search engine: it returns catalog entries (name, address, stars, rating, review count) and no prices — for prices, track the hotel or use list_hotel_deals. Give a city, region or airport name (Korean, Japanese, Chinese or English) and, when the user named a hotel, the hotel filter; the city is resolved to the best catalog match. A hotel name alone (no city) also works for well-reviewed hotels: it searches every city and returns each hotel with its city — confirm the city with the user before tracking. If it finds nothing, ask for the city. If several cities match, other_city_matches lists them — pass one of their city_id values (instead of city) to search that city. Typical flow: search_hotels → track_hotel_price → get_price_history.

city.description: City, region or airport name, e.g. "Sapporo", "삿포로", "札幌". Optional when hotel is given; otherwise required unless city_id is given.

city_id.description: Catalog city id from a previous result (other_city_matches). Overrides city.

hotel.description: Hotel name, e.g. "Hilton Sapporo", "신라호텔", "ソウル新羅ホテル". With a city it filters that city; without a city it searches well-reviewed hotels in every city. Omit (with a city) to list notable hotels.

name: search_hotels
title: Find the agoda_hotel_id for a hotel
